token = access_token

# Re-fetch playlists (authoritative and for safety)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_playlists = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlists_page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else None)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))
playlist_ids = [p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists]
print('playlist_ids', playlist_ids)

# Build mapping of pre-2021 songs per playlist
pre2021 = {}  # playlist_id -> list of song_ids released before 2021
release_before = '2021-01-01'

for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    song_ids_in_pl = [s['id'] for s in songs]
    print('playlist', pid, pl.get('title'), 'songs_count', len(song_ids_in_pl))

    pre_ids = []
    for sid in song_ids_in_pl:
        sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        rd = sd.get('release_date')
        if rd is not None and rd < release_before:
            pre_ids.append(sid)
    pre2021[pid] = sorted(pre_ids)
    print('  pre2021_song_ids', pre2021[pid], 'count', len(pre2021[pid]))

print('total_pre2021_songs_in_playlists', sum(len(v) for v in pre2021.values()))
print('pre2021_map', pre2021)

    print('verify_playlists_page',page_index,'count',len(resp) if resp else None)
    if not resp:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

playlist_ids=[p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists]
print('playlist_ids',playlist_ids)

pre_remaining={}
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid,access_token=token)
    song_ids=[s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs',[])]
    pre_ids=[]
    for sid in song_ids:
        sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        rd=sd.get('release_date')
        if rd is not None and rd<release_before:
            pre_ids.append(sid)
    pre_remaining[pid]=sorted(pre_ids)
    print('playlist',pid,'title',pl.get('title'),'songs',len(song_ids),'pre2021_remaining',pre_remaining[pid])

print('total_pre2021_remaining_in_playlists',sum(len(v) for v in pre_remaining.values()))
